buildings.name: Animal Biomass Powerplant
buildings.description: Produces energy out of Animal Biomass from fallen enemies.

buildings.name: Carbonium Powerplant
buildings.description: Must be built on top of a Carbonium Ore deposit. Provides good power output but uses up resources from the deposit. Can use only unrefined Carbonium straight from the ground.

buildings.name: Energy Pylon
buildings.description: The Energy Relay system allows the Riftbreaker to transfer energy over long distances without the use of Energy Connectors. At least two pylons are necessary for this technology to work properly.

buildings.name: Energy Storage
buildings.description: Stores a significant amount of energy. Best used with intermittent power sources like Solar Panels to create an energy buffer.

buildings.name: Fusion Powerplant
buildings.description: Very large energy output. Produces plasma resource as a byproduct.

buildings.name: Gas Powerplant
buildings.description: Produces a significant amount of energy but requires Flammable Gas to operate.

buildings.name: Geothermal Powerplant
buildings.description: Must be built on top of a Geothermal Vent. Produces significant amounts of energy.

buildings.name: Large Energy Storage
buildings.description: Large Energy Storage is a high-capacity facility designed to store significant amounts of excess energy for later use.

buildings.name: Magma Powerplant
buildings.description: Uses liquid Magma to produce large amounts of Energy. Needs to be connected to liquid Magma with Pipelines.

buildings.name: Morphium Power Plant
buildings.description: This Power Plant captures the excess energy resulting from the nuclear synthesis and decay processes naturally occurring in Morphium. Provides the power grid with a steady flow of energy at a low upkeep cost.

buildings.name: Nuclear Powerplant
buildings.description: It has very large Energy output.

buildings.name: Plant Biomass Powerplant
buildings.description: Produces energy out of Plant Biomass from destroyed foliage.

buildings.name: Solar Panels
buildings.description: Provides Energy during the day hours. Shuts down automatically during the night, or when the sun is not visible e.g. during intense storms.

buildings.name: Wind Turbine
buildings.description: Provides a limited amount of energy depending on wind strength.

buildings.name: Advanced Magnetic Stabilizer
buildings.description: Stabilizes the big rift portal with alien based tech. More advanced than standard version. Does not need cooling.

buildings.name: Armory
buildings.description: Allows crafting of new weapons and items. Automatically produces and instantly transports ammunition and supplies to the Mecha-Suit.

buildings.name: Communication HUB
buildings.description: Allows communicating with Earth via quantum entanglement and downloading schematics for buildings and upgrades. Enables research. Transmission is instant regardless of distance but has very low bandwidth.

buildings.name: Headquarters
buildings.description: The central building in your base. It allows the Mecha-Suit to reconstruct, includes a rift portal and provides storage facilities. Protect this building at any cost.

buildings.name: Laboratory
buildings.description: Provides advanced research facilities that are required to develop technologies based on extreaterrestrial fauna and flora.

buildings.name: Orbital Scanner
buildings.description: Constantly scans the whole planet to detect valuable resources, artifacts, new species and other phenomena outside the main base area. Allows rift jumping to planetary missions.

buildings.name: Outpost
buildings.description: A miniature version of the Headquarters building. Can be constructed during planetary missions to transport resources from remote bases to the main base via rift technology. It allows the Mecha-Suit to reconstruct.

buildings.name: Repellent Drone Hub
buildings.description: Repellent Drone Hub sends out specialized drones that spray the target area with a repellent substance according to the Riftbreaker's current needs.

buildings.name: Research Station
buildings.description: This building contains a robust set of sensors and analysis facilities. It is used to gather research data from objects or anomalies that are too complicated to be scanned by Mr. Rigg's field equipment.

buildings.name: Rift Magnetic Stabilizer
buildings.description: Stabilizes the big rift portal. Needs Water or Supercoolant to operate.

buildings.name: Rift Station
buildings.description: This is the big rift that can connect planets in different parts of the galaxy. Can open a rift back to Earth.

buildings.name: Seismic Laboratory
buildings.description: This building contains very precise seismographic equipment that collects data for large-scale geological analysis of the area. Needs a constant supply of water for cooling purposes.

buildings.name: Weather Control Station
buildings.description: Predicts extreme weather conditions and allows to control them to a certain extent.

buildings.name: Bio Composter
buildings.description: Produces Flammable Gas out of Plant Biomass.

buildings.name: Carbonium Factory
buildings.description: Produces Carbonium. Must be placed on a Carbonium Ore deposit and powered with Energy to operate.

buildings.name: Carbonium Synthesizer
buildings.description: Synthesizes Carbonium from Energy. Can be used as an infinite source of Carbonium but consumes a lot of energy in the process which makes it not very economical.

buildings.name: Crystal Collector
buildings.description: Sends out automatic drones that gather crystal resources in a radius around the building.

buildings.name: Cultivator
buildings.description: This plant plants plants :)

buildings.name: Drone Mine
buildings.description: The Drone Mine is a hub for a fleet of automated drones that will collect solid resources of all varieties within the operating radius of the Mine.

buildings.name: Gas Extractor
buildings.description: Place this structure on top of a Gas Vent to extinguish it and start collecting the Flammable Gas escaping from beneath the ground.

buildings.name: Gas Filtering Plant
buildings.description: Refines Sludge to produce Flammable Gas which is used as fuel by the Gas Powerplants. Requires a constant flow of sludge that can be connected by using pipelines.

buildings.name: Harvesting Station
buildings.description: Sends out automatic drones that gather alien flora in a radius around the building. This process generates all kinds of resources depending on what was gathered.

buildings.name: Ionizer
buildings.description: Produces Plasma out of other resources.

buildings.name: Ironium Factory
buildings.description: Produces Ironium. Must be placed on Iron Ore deposits.

buildings.name: Ironium Synthesizer
buildings.description: Synthesizes Ironium using Energy. Can be used in an emergency situation when Ironium is depleted but Energy is abundant.

buildings.name: Liquid Compressor
buildings.description: This facility is used to compress liquid resources on a subatomic level to allow their transportation over long distances using the Rift Technology.

buildings.name: Liquid Decompressor
buildings.description: The reception terminal for liquids transported using the Rift Technology. This facility restores the liquids treated by the Liquid Compressor to their original form.

buildings.name: Liquid Pump
buildings.description: Pumps liquid resources from pools found around the planet. Pumps can not operate too close to each other.

buildings.name: Loot Collector
buildings.description: The Loot Collector Tower is a hub for automated drones that will scavenge all the resources and materials dropped within the tower's area of operation.

buildings.name: Plasma Converter
buildings.description: Converts Plasma into Supercharged Plasma by using large amounts of energy.

buildings.name: Rare Element Mine
buildings.description: Mines rare resources like Uranium, Titanium and Palladium. Must be placed on an ore deposit and powered with Energy to operate.

buildings.name: Supercoolant Refinery
buildings.description: Produces Supercoolant resource for advanced buildings.

buildings.name: Tower Ammo Factory
buildings.description: Produces ammunition for Defense Towers.

buildings.name: Uranium Centrifuge
buildings.description: Refines Uranium Ore. Produces Uranium for use in powerplants and crafting.

buildings.name: Water Filtering Plant
buildings.description: Purifies contaminated fluids like mud and produces clean water. Requires Energy to operate.

buildings.name: Acid Shredder Tower
buildings.description: Acid Shredder Tower is a rapid-fire defense structure that saturates nearby targets with corrosive acid projectiles. It excels at eliminating large groups of small enemies thanks to projectiles splitting on impact and hitting multiple targets at once.

buildings.name: Acid Spewer Tower
buildings.description: This defensive tower covers the ground with highly concentrated hydrofluoric acid. The acid will damage any organic matter that comes into contact with it.

buildings.name: AI Hub
buildings.description: Provides AI Cores that are required to manage more buildings with artificial intelligence like Sentinel Towers or the Repair Facility.

buildings.name: Artillery Tower
buildings.description: Shoots explosive shells at long distances. Very effective against groups of enemies. Can shoot farther than its viewing range. Requires a Tower Ammunition Factory to operate.

buildings.name: Attack Drone Tower
buildings.description: Spawns defensive drones which hoover in the tower's operational radius and attack all enemies that come in range.

buildings.name: Flamer Tower
buildings.description: Sprays burning fluid. Short range but very effective against numerous small enemies. Requires a Tower Ammunition Factory to operate.

buildings.name: Gatling Laser Tower
buildings.description: A large, energy-based defensive tower. Rapidly shoots powerful plasma projectiles. Its high stopping power comes at a cost of significant energy consumption.

buildings.name: HCM Tower
buildings.description: A silo, housing a massive rocket launched vertically and aimed at distant targets. Once the rocket reaches destination, it releases multiple explosive devices that cover a very large area. Gas supply required.

buildings.name: Heavy Artillery Tower
buildings.description: Shoots mini nuke explosive shells at very long distances. Can protect the base from enemies shooting from a long distance. Use with Radars to shoot farther than its viewing range.

buildings.name: Icicle Tower
buildings.description: Icicle Tower fires ice projectiles that deal cryo damage and significantly slow down enemies. It is effective at controlling enemy movement and reducing the pressure from advancing waves.

buildings.name: Inferno Tower
buildings.description: Inferno Tower fires cluster grenades that split into smaller payloads while airborne. After landing, they detonate with a short delay, setting targets on fire and dealing sustained damage over an area.

buildings.name: Laser Tower
buildings.description: Shoots a constant beam of energy at a target. The beam gets more powerful while constantly hitting the target so its best used against large and heavily armored units.

buildings.name: Lightning Tower
buildings.description: The weaponized electromagnet embedded within this tower creates an enormous disparity between itself and all organic matter around it. Thanks to that, it can create a powerful, but controllable electric arc that can affect multiple attackers.

buildings.name: Mine Layer Tower
buildings.description: Spawns mines in the area of operation which in time create a mine field that is very hard for enemies to go through.

buildings.name: Minigun Tower
buildings.description: Minigun version of the base tower. Very high fire rate makes it effective against a wide range of enemies.

buildings.name: Plasma Tower
buildings.description: Shoots high powered energy projectiles with a decent fire rate. It's quite universal and can defend your base against creatures that are resistant to physical damage. Uses energy to shoot so can be a good diversification if your tower ammo production is struggling to keep up.

buildings.name: Portal Bomb Tower
buildings.description: Using a short-range Rift Portal, this defensive tower will deliver an armed warhead, prioritizing long-range hostile units. Thanks to instant delivery of the payload, this tower circumvents the problems connected with conventional artillery use.

buildings.name: Power Rod Tower
buildings.description: The Power Rod Tower launches long-range warheads. Upon reaching the target, a Power Rod emerges from the warhead. It produces high-voltage electric arcs, damaging nearby units.

buildings.name: Radar
buildings.description: Provides radar coverage and enables defense towers to shoot beyond their viewing range. Detects hostile entities and shows them on the map. Great for spotting incoming attacks.

buildings.name: Railgun Tower
buildings.description: Shoots a really powerful, piercing energy beam. Very low fire rate. Each shot consumes a significant portion of Energy from the main energy supply.

buildings.name: Repair Facility
buildings.description: Repairs damaged buildings in a radius around this facility using automated drones.

buildings.name: Rocket Tower
buildings.description: Shoots explosive rockets at the enemies. Best used against groups of enemies or creatures that are vulnerable to area damage.

buildings.name: Sentinel Tower
buildings.description: Basic defensive tower. Shoots high speed energy projectiles at a limited rate of fire.

buildings.name: Shield Generator
buildings.description: Adds shield protection to all structures in a radius.

buildings.name: Shockwave Tower
buildings.description: Emits powerful waves that freeze and damages enemies in a radius. Very good for slowing down enemy hordes and against creates vulnerable to cryo damage.

buildings.name: Shotgun Tower
buildings.description: This tower utilizes High-Caliber Tower Ammo. It rapidly shoots short-ranged volleys of small projectiles. It is very effective against large groups of small attackers.

buildings.name: Tower AA Basic
buildings.description: Basic Anti Air Defensive Tower. Shoots high speed energy projectiles at a limited rate of fire. Each shot consumes Energy from the main energy supply.

buildings.name: Arcology Workshop
buildings.description: Enables the construction of Arcologies - self-sufficient structures capable of sustaining life in any environment.

buildings.name: Gravitational Hyper Lens
buildings.description: Enables the construction of gigantic structures in zero-gravity environments. Allows for object detection through geomagnetic mapping.

buildings.name: Hydroponic Lab
buildings.description: Conducts research and development of modified flora. Greatly increases vegetation growth speed within the location it is built in.

buildings.name: Nanobot Center
buildings.description: Manages large nanobot construction swarms over long distances. Provides additional AI Cores in all planetary locations.

buildings.name: Prime Rift Station
buildings.description: Enables long-distance interplanetary rift jumps to a single destination. Produces a pair of Quantum Entanglement Cores.

buildings.name: Quantum Cortex Lab
buildings.description: Advanced Quantum Computing datacenter. Enables reprocessing of megastructure schematics and greatly increases research speed.

buildings.description: Provides light during night time, must be connected to the energy grid.
